add_user.title: Add a user
add_user.description: The Bitmoji ID is not shown on avatar-explorer.pages.dev: that site downloads the images, it does not give you the ID. You can find it on bitmoji.com, once logged in, with the browser developer tools (F12). Expected format: letters, digits, dashes and underscores, e.g. 123456789012_1-s5.

settings.title: Avatar Explorer synchronization
settings.description: The language sets the title and keywords of the poses, and therefore the names of the downloaded files. Each language offers a different number of poses (1261 in French, 1975 in English).

error.duplicate_folder: This folder name is already used by another user.
error.invalid_bitmoji_id: Invalid Bitmoji ID: letters, digits, dashes and underscores only.
error.duo_same_user: The two Duo mode users must be different.

init.title: Avatar Explorer synchronization
init.description:
Configured users: {users}.

The Bitmoji ID is not shown on avatar-explorer.pages.dev: you can find it on bitmoji.com, once logged in, with the browser developer tools (F12). Expected format: letters, digits, dashes and underscores, e.g. 123456789012_1-s5.

⚠️ Changing a Bitmoji ID or the quality triggers a full re-import (same file names, different content).

⚠️ Changing the language downloads a whole new set of images: file names come from the translated titles. Old images stay on disk and the avatars currently displayed will have to be selected again.

lovelace_yaml_resource.title: Avatar Explorer card: update the Lovelace resource
lovelace_yaml_resource.description:
Your dashboards use YAML mode, so the integration cannot update the card resource itself. The card is now served at a new URL: the old {legacy_url} no longer works.

In configuration.yaml, under lovelace: resources:, replace the card entry with:

- url: {url}
  type: module

Then restart Home Assistant. This issue disappears once the resource is up to date.
